insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified in provided extract (varies as per Policy Schedule; examples mention 5L, 7.5L, 10L, 15L, 20L, 25L, 50L, 1Cr, Unlimited)

great.name: Room rent: Any room (no capping)
great.quote: (i) Room Rent (Any Room), Boarding, Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home
great.reference: Section II - Coverage > BASIC COVER > 1. In-patient Treatment (page 5/37)
great.explanation: Default room eligibility is 'Any Room' (no room rent limit), which helps avoid room-rent linked deductions.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization: 90 days
great.quote: Pre-hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 90 days immediately before the insured person is hospitalized.
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 90 days before admission (better than standard 30–60 days).

great.name: Restore benefit: Unlimited restoration up to 100% each time (same/different illness; subsequent hospitalization)
great.quote: Automatic Restoration of Sum Insured... Sum Insured will be restored unlimited number of times and maximum up to 100% each time... 2nd Claim (For Same / different illness)
great.explanation: Strong restore: can refill the base Sum Insured multiple times for later hospitalizations, including same illness (subject to the 'subsequent hospitalization' condition).

great.name: NCB / Cumulative Bonus: 50% per claim-free year up to 100%, and does NOT reduce unless utilized
great.quote: Cumulative Bonus... 50% of sum insured for each claim free year and maximum up to 100%... Cumulative bonus will not be reduced unless the same is utilized in the event of claim... unutilized Cumulative bonus will be carried forward
great.explanation: Bonus is protected: it doesn't reset to zero just because you claim; it reduces only to the extent used.

great.name: Organ donor expenses: covered and stated as over & above Sum Insured
great.quote: Organ Donor Expenses... Note: The coverage limit under this benefit is upto the sum insured and over and above the sum insured.
great.explanation: Organ donor hospitalization expenses are covered, and the wording indicates an additional benefit over the Sum Insured.

great.name: Modern treatments covered up to Sum Insured (robotic surgery etc.)
great.quote: Coverage for Modern Treatments: The following procedures will be covered... g) Robotic surgeries ... h) Stereotactic radio surgeries ...
great.explanation: Modern treatment procedures are covered up to the Sum Insured (wording does not show specific sub-limits here).

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (not applicable for accidents)
good.quote: 30-day waiting period – Code Excl 03 (Not Applicable for Accidents)... within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illnesses; accidents are exempt.

good.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: 36 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer
good.explanation: PED waiting period is 36 months, which is within the 2–4 year industry-standard range.

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Specified disease / procedure waiting period... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: 24 months is standard for listed specific diseases/procedures.

good.name: Post-hospitalization: 180 days
good.quote: Post Hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 180 days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital.
good.explanation: 180 days is at the upper end of standard post-hospitalization coverage.

good.name: Air ambulance cover (limit ₹5,00,000 per policy year)
good.quote: Air Ambulance... reimbursement of expenses incurred towards the cost of air ambulance service up to Rs.5,00,000/- in a policy year
good.explanation: Air ambulance is covered with a stated annual cap, which is a useful add-on-like benefit within base cover.

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered (with listed condition exclusions)
good.quote: Domiciliary Hospitalization: Coverage for medical treatment (including AYUSH) for a period exceeding three days... taken whilst confined at home...
good.explanation: Home-based treatment (domiciliary) is covered subject to conditions and a list of illnesses not covered under this section.

bad.name: Consumables (non-medical items) not covered by default (only via optional cover)
bad.quote: Coverage for Non-medical Items (Consumables): Items as per List I will become payable If there is an admissible claim... If insured opts this coverage
bad.explanation: By default, common consumables/non-medical items can be out-of-pocket unless you buy the consumables optional cover.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization is 180 days (not >180 days for GREAT threshold)
bad.quote: Post Hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 180 days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital.
bad.explanation: Mandatory reporting: post-hospitalization is 180 days (good), but it does not exceed 180 days for the GREAT bracket.

unclear.name: Co-pay (base plan): not explicitly stated; optional co-pay covers exist
unclear.quote: Co-Payment: Co-payment means a cost sharing requirement... provides that the policyholder / insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
unclear.reference: Definitions (page 2/37); Optional Covers include Smart Network co-pay and Voluntary Co-payment (pages 12/37, 16/37)
unclear.explanation: The wording defines co-pay and lists optional co-pay features, but the base policy’s default co-pay (0% vs any mandatory co-pay) is not clearly stated in the provided extract. Verify in your policy schedule.

unclear.name: Cashless network size: not mentioned
unclear.quote: Cashless facility... payments... are directly made to the network provider by the insurer
unclear.explanation: The document explains cashless facility but does not state the number of network hospitals. Verify current network count on insurer website/app.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
